note: Synthetic sentences an agent might write; gaps = how many clauses are real 'I have not done X' gaps. Written by hand, not from any real session. The first 30 tuned the filter; the next 20 were a held-out set (precision 0.71 before, then used for tuning); the last 15 were a second held-out set, never tuned on (precision 0.82, recall 1.0). known_miss marks the filter's known false positives there.
